svg.text: server.py keeps one SessionRegistry for the process and opens one PinnedExecutor
(one daemon thread) per chat socket: a SQLCipher connection must stay on the
PIP is written mostly as module-level functions (one run() per stage; store functions that take the database connection first), so this
shows every class it has outside the tests, except the event TypedDicts of shared/ws_spec.py and a few private helpers.
